speaker: Doctor
text: Do the lesions have a central indentation or umbilication, and are they located anywhere else besides the abdomen? I would also like to examine the lesions closely, so may I REQUEST IMAGES of the affected areas?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Previously healthy, up-to-date immunizations, no significant illnesses. Social history: Attends daycare three times per week.

speaker: Doctor
text: The images confirm the classic pearly, umbilicated papules, which, combined with the daycare exposure, strongly points to Molluscum Contagiosum. I have sufficient information to conclude. DIAGNOSIS READY: Molluscum Contagiosum.
